costScope: Historical three-year full-recipient coverage sensitivity only; ranked ordinary-gift donor estimate withdrawn. Recognized operating expense includes netted event benefits, excludes the separate foundation and avoids transfer duplication. Other portfolio and societal returns remain unpriced.
geographicAttribution: g=1 only for the explicitly California-filtered coverage cohort. This is not the share of all organizational or national litigation benefits.
formula: Historical diagnostic only, not an expected donor return: C=3*7409717=22229151; QCA=N*u*p*a*b*q*(1/1.03+r/1.03^2). Legacy central N=100000,u=.1,p=.2,a=.2,b=.25,q=.02,r=.5 gives 2.8843434819492884 conditional QALYs. Conditional price10=10*C/QCA if positive. No benefit after year two; actual gift-responsive inputs remain unidentified.
counterfactual: Without the additional gift, existing staff, restricted grants, foundation transfers, public agencies, lawmakers, local legal aid and co-counsel continue their planned work. Count only a change in success probability, timing, scope or implementation above that counterfactual; settled historical cases are not purchased anew. Already mandatory call reporting continues; only additional coverage resolution beyond it enters this branch. Benefits begin during the three-year effort. An additional three-year delay raises the price by 1.03^3, about 9.3%.
attribution: p is coalition-level success of a specified extra implementation change; a is WCLP's causal share of that change; b is ordinary-funding responsiveness after replacement donors and existing financing. Unlike the prior DeltaP formulation, p does not already include a or b. These distinct assumptions are not empirically calibrated.
uncertainty: Headline withdrawn after September 30 in-depth review. The old population, uptake, implementation, attribution and gift-response values are unsupported hypothetical inputs, not calibrated priors. Joint cases are not confidence bounds. Zero and harm remain possible; unpriced portfolio benefit is not zero.
nativeOutcomes: Historical hypothetical only: 10,000 first-year net coverage equivalents become 100 conditional first-year equivalents after p*a*b, plus 50 in year two. Neither the cohort nor WCLP-attributable extra coverage was measured. Calls, training and eligibility are not coverage equivalents.

inputs.name: Cannual
inputs.rationale: 7230364 reported operating expense plus 179353 direct event benefits.

inputs.name: cost years
inputs.rationale: Full recipient cost over a bounded implementation period.

inputs.name: N
inputs.rationale: Unobserved at-risk cohort hypothesis, not dataset call volume; sensitivity 10000–250000.

inputs.name: u
inputs.rationale: Beyond normal renewal, other insurance and navigation; test .01–.1.

inputs.name: p
inputs.rationale: Not historical policy win rate; test .05–.5.

inputs.name: b
inputs.rationale: Replacement financing and existing resources; test .05–.5.

inputs.name: q
inputs.rationale: Attenuated 40% of approximately .05 Oregon mapped health-state difference; requires one-year persistence, not measured California yield; test .005–.05.

inputs.name: r
inputs.rationale: No benefit after year two; test .25–.9.

inputs.name: g
inputs.rationale: Cohort explicitly limited to California residents.

inputs.name: outside costs
inputs.rationale: Medical, administrative and coalition resources not quantified.

inputs.name: other portfolio health
inputs.rationale: Housing, public benefits, dentures and birth-center effects unpriced.

scenarios.label: Estimate withdrawn — gift-responsive coverage effect unidentified
scenarios.assumptions: No named incremental ordinary-gift workplan or observed additional coverage. Unknown is not zero; the legacy calculation below is not an expected donor return.

scenarios.label: Historical alpha central — diagnostic only
scenarios.assumptions: N=100000;u=0.1;p=0.2;a=0.2;b=0.25;q=0.02; second-year retention=0.5; three-year cost, at most two coverage years;3% discount. Unsupported conditional inputs, not measured WCLP outcomes.

scenarios.label: low
scenarios.assumptions: N=10000;u=0.01;p=0.05;a=0.05;b=0.05;q=0.005; second-year retention=0.25; three-year cost, at most two coverage years;3% discount. Explicit subjective scenario, not measured WCLP probabilities.

scenarios.label: high
scenarios.assumptions: N=250000;u=0.1;p=0.5;a=0.3;b=0.5;q=0.05; second-year retention=0.9; three-year cost, at most two coverage years;3% discount. Explicit subjective scenario, not measured WCLP probabilities.

scenarios.label: No additional implementation
scenarios.assumptions: Complete substitution or no additional coverage.

scenarios.label: Illustrative net harm
scenarios.assumptions: One California QALY lost through adverse administrative or policy consequences; judgment stress case, not observed.

sensitivity: N,u,p,a,b dominate and remain unverified; no precise success probability is disguised as evidence.
Zero utility or complete replacement gives no health gain. Coverage duration is finite and may be shorter than assumed.
Adding outside resource cost E changes price to10*(22229151+E)/QCA.
No separate mortality, denture or housing QALYs are added to the coverage utility bridge.

Counterfactual success, timing and scope with and without that extra capacity, holding or modeling co-counsel and agency responses.
Unique marginal California recipients and care uptake, linked to actual coverage or treatment days rather than total eligibility.
Utility trajectories and evidence-transfer by age, condition, policy and replacement care; harms and duration/reversal.
Incremental medical, administrative and partner resources and overlap across policy and legal pathways.
